title: Tom’s Dog
story_text:
Tom has a small dog.
The dog likes to run in the yard.
Tom plays with his dog every day.
They are very happy together.

title: A Red Ball
story_text:
Lina has a red ball.
She throws it up high.
The ball falls to the ground.
She picks it up and laughs.

title: The Hungry Cat
story_text:
A cat is very hungry.
It looks for food in the kitchen.
It finds some fish in a bowl.
The cat eats and feels full.

title: Rainy Day Fun
story_text:
It is raining outside.
Mark wears his boots and coat.
He jumps in puddles with joy.
He smiles all day long.

title: At the Park
story_text:
Sara goes to the park.
She plays on the swing.
She slides down the slide.
She has so much fun.

title: The Lost Pencil
story_text:
Ben cannot find his pencil.
He looks under his desk.
He checks inside his bag.
At last, he finds it in his book.

title: Morning Routine
story_text:
Ella wakes up early.
She brushes her teeth.
She eats breakfast with her family.
Then she goes to school.

title: The Friendly Bird
story_text:
A bird sits on the window.
It sings a sweet song.
Lily gives it some seeds.
The bird chirps happily.

title: The Big Tree
story_text:
A big tree stands near the house.
It gives shade on sunny days.
Children sit under it and talk.
They enjoy the cool air.

title: The Clean Classroom
story_text:
The students clean the classroom.
They sweep the floor and wipe the tables.
They put books in the right place.
The room looks neat and nice.

title: The Slow Turtle
story_text:
A turtle walks very slowly.
Other animals run fast.
But the turtle keeps moving.
It reaches its home at last.

title: Helping Mom
story_text:
Nina helps her mom at home.
She washes the dishes.
She dries them and puts them away.
Her mom thanks her with a smile.

title: The New Student
story_text:
A new student comes to class.
He feels shy and quiet.
A classmate smiles and says hello.
Soon, they become friends.

title: The Broken Toy
story_text:
Jake’s toy car broke one day.
He felt sad and upset.
His father helped fix the toy.
Jake smiled and played again.

title: The Little Garden
story_text:
Mia plants seeds in the garden.
She waters them every day.
After some days, small plants grow.
She feels proud of her work.
